title: 9. Numeracy & Number Systems: Estimating Sums of Whole Numbers
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Estimate a sum of two two-digit numbers by rounding each addend to the nearest ten.
questions.question: Estimate \(38+24\) by rounding each number to the nearest ten. What estimate do you get?
questions.explanation: Round \(38\) to the nearest ten: \(38\) rounds to \(40\). Round \(24\) to the nearest ten: \(24\) rounds to \(20\). Then add the rounded numbers: \(40+20=60\). The exact sum \(62\) is not the rounded estimate. Therefore, the estimate is \(60\).
questions.hint: For each number, check its ones digit: \(0\) to \(4\) keeps the tens digit, \(5\) to \(9\) raises it by one. Then add the two rounded numbers.
